actions.description: Append rows of data to a push-dataset table.
actions.name: add-dataset-rows

rows.description: Rows to append (max 10,000 per call, per Power BI push-dataset limits). Each row is an object mapping column names to values.

actions.description: Grant a user or service principal access to a workspace.
actions.name: add-workspace-user

identifier.description: UPN, object id, or app id of the user or principal to add. Example: "user@contoso.com"

actions.description: Create a new, empty dashboard in a workspace.
actions.name: create-dashboard

groupId.description: Workspace (group) ID where the dashboard should be created. Example: "149ca924-4333-471b-94b5-347eca3f9938"

name.description: Name of the new dashboard. Example: "Registry Test Dashboard"

actions.description: Create a new dataset with an explicit table/column schema in push mode, ready to receive rows via the API without needing a .pbix file.
actions.name: create-push-dataset

actions.description: Create a new Power BI workspace.
actions.name: create-workspace

name.description: Name of the new workspace. Example: "Nango Test Workspace"

actions.description: Delete all rows from a push-dataset table (truncate)
actions.name: delete-dataset-rows

tableName.description: Table name within the dataset. Example: "SalesFact"

actions.description: Delete a dataset.
actions.name: delete-dataset

actions.description: Delete a workspace.
actions.name: delete-workspace

actions.description: Run a DAX query against a dataset and return the results
actions.name: execute-dataset-queries

queries.description: Exactly one DAX query to execute (the provider API supports only one query per call). Example: ["EVALUATE SalesFact"]

impersonatedUserName.description: UPN of a user to be impersonated

serializerSettings.description: Serialization settings for the result set

actions.description: Get the configured refresh schedule for a dataset.
actions.name: get-dataset-refresh-schedule

actions.description: Get details of a single dataset.
actions.name: get-dataset

actions.description: Get details of a single workspace.
actions.name: get-workspace

actions.description: List the tiles on a dashboard.
actions.name: list-dashboard-tiles

actions.description: List dashboards in a workspace.
actions.name: list-dashboards

actions.description: List dataflows in a workspace
actions.name: list-dataflows

actions.description: List the data sources backing a dataset.
actions.name: list-dataset-datasources

actions.description: List the refresh history of a dataset.
actions.name: list-dataset-refresh-history

actions.description: List users and service principals with direct access to a dataset.
actions.name: list-dataset-users

actions.description: List datasets in a workspace.
actions.name: list-datasets

actions.description: List on-premises data gateways visible to this service principal.
actions.name: list-gateways

actions.description: List reports in a workspace.
actions.name: list-reports

actions.description: List users and service principals with access to a workspace.
actions.name: list-workspace-users

actions.description: List Power BI workspaces (groups) accessible to this service principal.
actions.name: list-workspaces

actions.description: Trigger a refresh of a dataset.
actions.name: refresh-dataset

notifyOption.description: Notification option for refresh completion. Defaults to NoNotification.

actions.description: Transfer ownership of a dataset's data source credentials to the caller.
actions.name: takeover-dataset

actions.description: Configure the automatic refresh schedule for a dataset.
actions.name: update-dataset-refresh-schedule

enabled.description: Whether the refresh schedule is enabled.

days.description: Days of the week to refresh. Required (non-empty) when enabled is true. Example: ["Monday", "Tuesday"]

times.description: Times to refresh in 24-hour HH:mm format. Example: ["05:00", "17:00"]

actions.description: Replace a push dataset table's column schema.
actions.name: update-dataset-table-schema

columns.description: New column schema for the table

actions.description: Rename a workspace.
actions.name: update-workspace

workspaceId.description: The workspace (group) ID to update. Example: "149ca924-4333-471b-94b5-347eca3f9938"

name.description: The new name for the workspace.

syncs.description: Sync datasets across all workspaces accessible to this service principal.
syncs.name: datasets

syncs.description: Sync Power BI workspaces (groups) accessible to this service principal.
syncs.name: workspaces
